title: Na rakh ab chadar
body:
Na rakh ab chadar
Na rakh ab chaadar bazuo pe , tu nile daag chhupa nahi zahra ki jaan sharma nahi.....2
1) jo chaadar unjhli thi teri rang uska kaise laal hua....2, ab sar pe tere ay shehzadi...2 , wo kyu maujud rida nahi , zahra ki jaan......
<<DIVIDER>>
2) atthara jo tere bhai the kis baat pe tujhse ruth gaye....2 , wo shehzaade kyu saath nahi....2 kyu saath aebbas tera nahi, zahra ki........
<<DIVIDER>>
3) wo kaun jawaan hai saath tere hay kapde jiske khun me bhare....2
Un zakhmo se wo chur hua....2
ankhon se bhi khoon rukta nahi....
<<DIVIDER>>
4) wo bachhi jisko sine pe shabbir sulaya karte the...2
Meri aankhe dhund ke haar gayi....2
Kahi milta uska pata nahi....
<<DIVIDER>>
5) ek guncha dahan maasum bhi tha
Naam.uska asgar rakkha tha...2 Kyu khaali god rabab ki hai...2
Asbaab me kyu jhula nahi.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Rehaan karo har dam maatam, tum nauha padho har dam sarwar...2
Ye ek ebaadat hai aysi...2
Jo hoti kabhi bhi qaza nahi
